note: Inputs of the excited-states article's plates (src/content/work/figures/excited-states/), one entry per file. source_path is under archive_root, read-only; md5 and size_bytes are of the committed file, source_md5 of the file it was copied from. Private documents are not among them.

3BSD.pdb.what: PDB 3BSD, 'Light harvesting protein from RC of Chlorobium tepidum' (HEADER 23-DEC-07, released 22-JAN-08, 2.30 A): the FMO complex, one protein chain A (2,798 ATOM records) with eight bacteriochlorophyll a residues (BCL A 367-373 of 66 atoms each, A 400 of 42 atoms; 504 atoms) and 178 HOH. Ben-Shem, Frolow, Nelson, FEBS Lett. 564, 274 (2004), doi:10.1016/S0014-5793(04)00360-6. The file is the PDB's own, as downloaded in October 2015; its AUTHOR record spells Ben-Shem 'BRN-SHEM'.
3BSD.pdb.edit: One line removed, the lone magnesium ion 'HETATM 3262 MG    MG A 374      39.661 124.026 127.725  0.33 51.51          MG' (source line 4069), which would otherwise draw as a loose sphere. Nothing else changed: the HET/HETNAM/FORMUL/MASTER records still count it, and four CONECT records that name atom 3262 (3262 to 3480-3482, and the three reverse records) now point at a missing atom. boxprep.read_pdb ignores CONECT and render_box_grid.prepare writes only ATOM and HETATM records, so the render is unaffected.
3BSD.pdb.edit_check: diff against the source shows exactly one deleted line
3BSD.pdb.checked_before_use: chain A only (2,798 ATOM records), 8 BCL residues with 504 atoms, 178 HOH, no HETATM left outside BCL and HOH, 522 CONECT records in the source (none are read), no alternate locations

chromophore-1.xyz.what: FMO bacteriochlorophyll a no. 1 as the JCTC 2017 calculations used it: 76 atoms (33 C, 34 H, 1 Mg, 4 N, 4 O), phytyl tail replaced by methyl, the LC-wPBE/6-31G** geometry superposed on the crystal frame (Fornari, Rowe, Padula, Troisi, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 13, 3754 (2017), p.4-5; thesis p.16). Mg at 46.20, 152.12, 136.71. Its coordinates match neither local PDB frame (3BSD, 3ENI), consistent with the P. aestuarii entry 3EOJ, which is not on disk: the plate that uses it must not name the organism or the entry.
chromophore-1.xyz.edit: none; a verbatim copy, name lower-cased with a hyphen
chromophore-1.xyz.format_quirk: Count line '76', blank comment line, space-separated columns.

chromophore-2.xyz.what: FMO bacteriochlorophyll a no. 2, as chromophore-1.xyz. The all-atom minimum separation from chromophore 1 is 2.2613 A (an oxygen and a hydrogen), the 2.26 A of the paper's Table 1, pair 1-2.
chromophore-2.xyz.edit: none; a verbatim copy, name lower-cased with a hyphen
chromophore-2.xyz.format_quirk: Count line '76', blank comment line, space-separated columns.

fmo-natural.xyz.what: The natural arrangement of the eight FMO bacteriochlorophyll a, 608 atoms (264 C, 272 H, 8 Mg, 32 N, 32 O; eight chromophores of 76 atoms), centred on the midpoint of the source and drain chromophores; identical to Geometries/Geometry_00001.xyz, structure 1 of the library of Knee, Rowe, Smith, Troisi, Datta, J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 8, 2328 (2017).
fmo-natural.xyz.format_quirk: The count line is the atom count plus a tab, the comment line is blank, columns are tab-separated and the element symbol is padded with a space. boxprep.read_xyz reads the file as it is (it splits on any whitespace and skips the comment line), so no extension was needed; scripts/tests/test_excited_states_data_provenance.py reads the staged files through it.

fmo-generated-00300.xyz.what: Structure 300 of the 50,000 generated rearrangements of the eight chromophores (Geometries/Geometry_00001.xyz to Geometry_50000.xyz, dated 2017-01-19), same composition as the natural arrangement; source and drain (BChl 1 and 3) are at the same positions as in every file checked, the other six move. The JPCL paper's Fig. 1 shows structures 100, 200 and 300.
fmo-generated-00300.xyz.format_quirk: The count line is the atom count plus a tab, the comment line is blank, columns are tab-separated and the element symbol is padded with a space. boxprep.read_xyz reads the file as it is (it splits on any whitespace and skips the comment line), so no extension was needed; scripts/tests/test_excited_states_data_provenance.py reads the staged files through it.

table1-short-range-share.json.source_path: ../papers/excitonic-interactions/paper.pdf (the WRAP accepted manuscript of the JCTC paper, outside the archive; PDF page = manuscript page + 1)
table1-short-range-share.json.source_pointer: Table 1, manuscript p.11 (PDF p.12); the 7 A threshold is on manuscript p.9. Tabulated in docs/dossiers/excited-states/dossier.md section 2.1.
table1-short-range-share.json.what: The fifteen own-data rows of Table 1 of Fornari, Rowe, Padula and Troisi, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 13, 3754 (2017): system (FMO, LH2, PCP), pair, minimum distance D in angstrom, coupled states, J_TOT and J_short in meV and the printed share J_short/J_TOT. FMO's D equal the all-atom minima of the archive's chromophore files (pair 1-2: 2.261 A).
table1-short-range-share.json.edit: Typed from the page into JSON; not a copy of a file. The two Scholes et al. comparison rows of LH2 are left out.
